sections.heading: What OleMiss is known for
paragraphs: The University of Mississippi, commonly known as OleMiss, is a public institution recognized for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 21,473 students. The university maintains an admission rate of approximately 96.58%, reflecting its inclusive approach to higher education. OleMiss is particularly noted for its strong programs in business and health fields, with business programs comprising about 29.3% of the academic offerings and health-related programs accounting for roughly 18.83%. These areas contribute to the university's reputation as a comprehensive public university serving a broad student population.

sections.heading: How to read OleMiss tuition
paragraphs: The University of Mississippi (OleMiss) provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. In-state tuition is set at $9,772, reflecting the reduced cost for residents of Mississippi. Out-of-state students are charged a higher tuition rate of $28,600, which accounts for the additional expenses associated with non-resident enrollment. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with fees, housing, meals, and other related expenses, totals $28,660. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families anticipate the financial commitment required to attend OleMiss.
